Key Features
16*10/100/1000Base-T RJ45 PoE, 8*1G Combo RJ45/SFP, 4*1G/2.5/10GGBase-X SFP+ slots
DC/DC redundant DC44-57V input with polarity reverse/over-current protection
Comply with IEEE802.3af PoE, IEEE802.3at PoE+ and IEEE802.3bt PoE++ standard
Support USB one key configuration & upgrading
DI/DO/RS485 is optional
Layer 3 features: Support IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server
Layer 2 features: VLAN; ERPS, STP/RSTP/MSTP; Link aggregation, IGMP snooping, port mirroring
QinQ, 802.1X, port isolation, RMON, NTP client, DHCP snooping/client, Ping/Tracert test, ACL, QoS
and SFP DDM function
Management and maintenance: IPv4 /IPv6 management, PoE management
Support Web, SNMP, CLI, Telnet/SSH management method; Support user management, system log, Configuration upload/download through web interface, firmware upgrade via HTTP/TFTP/USB
Support G.8032 ERPS protocol, recovery time≤20ms
Support 6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
IP40 fan-less and rack-mount hardware design
Operation temperature: -40℃~+75℃
It is an ideal solution for IP surveillance, wind, electricity, assembly automation, subway PIS, power SCADA, sewage treatment, metallurgy, intelligent transportation, rail transportation, military and other industries

Data & Alarm
Explanation
RS485 Data is a common serial communication protocol widely used to connect sensors, controllers etc.
The DI/DO(digital input/output)alarm system is used to detect changes in equipment status and issue an alarm
Digital input(DI)can receive signals from external devices, such as equipment failure, sensor abnormality, etc.
Digital output(DO)is used to control external devices, such as turning on or off alarm lights, ringing bells, etc.
When detecting an abnormal state, the DI/DO system will trigger an alarm to notify the operator to take timely action
Application
Industrial Automation
Intelligent Manufacturing
Monitoring System
Connection
[Sensors/Devices]--(RS485)--[Industrial Ethernet Switch]--(DI/DO)--[Alarm Device]
Sensors/Devices
Sensors or devices are connected to the industrial switch through the RS485 bus for data transmission
For example, temperature sensors, pressure sensors, etc.
Industrial Ethernet Switch
The industrial switch is responsible for managing connected devices and receives data from sensors via the 	RS485 interface
It has built-in DI/DO interfaces for connecting alarm devices
When abnormal sensor data is detected, it triggers the alarm device through the DO interface
Alarm Device
Alarm devices, such as warning lights or buzzers, are connected to the industrial switch via the DI interface
When an alarm signal is received, the device generates a visual or audible alert to notify the operator
